title: Diesel Heating in Zero-Emission Bus Fleets: Stochastic Planning under Winter Uncertainty: reproduction package
description: Code, inputs, archived solver results and logs reproducing every number, table and figure of 'Diesel Heating in Zero-Emission Bus Fleets: Stochastic Planning under Winter Uncertainty'. Two-stage stochastic MILP for cold-climate battery-electric bus fleet planning with fuel-fired-heater retention, EVSE-coupled preconditioning, emissions policy and division-scale coordination. This version (v2.1.1, the v9 campaign) supersedes v2.0.1: the cost inputs are aligned with the companion study (Liu et al., Applied Energy, in press): 2026 Toronto Hydro demand charges, a +3.7% extended-battery traction penalty, the corrected charger cost point, and an hourly energy price at the companion study's 0.12 CAD/kWh level; scenario weights come from 24 winters of ECCC data. All results changed. It adds sensitivity variants for the companion study's declared ranges, heat-pump heating, minimum plug sessions, battery wear and daily-minimum weights.
